# Keep Hustling

> Keep Hustling (keephustling.in) is the personal website of Arsalaan Mohammed, an Associate Product Manager at Convin.ai in Bangalore and a B.Tech graduate of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. It covers his product work, side builds, product case studies, and a blog about AI products and his journey.

Arsalaan works on AI products for enterprise contact centres: self-hosted LLM infrastructure (a 65% cut in LLM costs), multilingual voice agents, and a no-code QA rule engine. Before Convin he was a Junior Product Manager at Aspire in Singapore. Contact: arsalaan.bdc@gmail.com.

## About

- [Home](https://keephustling.in/): Who Arsalaan is, what he is working on now, his journey from Darjeeling to IIT Dhanbad to product management, and testimonials.
- [Resume (PDF)](https://keephustling.in/Mohammed_Resume_2026.pdf): One-page resume with experience, achievements, projects and skills.

## Work

- [All work](https://keephustling.in/work): Overview of roles and side builds.
- [Convin](https://keephustling.in/work/convin): Making enterprise conversation intelligence cheaper, smarter, and self-serve.
- [Aspire](https://keephustling.in/work/aspire): Migrating high-value accounts and automating SME accounting, without breaking trust.
- [Stayora](https://keephustling.in/work/stayora): Hotel booking for India, with an AI travel agent that plans the whole trip and waits for approval before anyone pays.
- [Product OS](https://keephustling.in/work/product-os): A self-hosted workspace for product work with a copilot that knows your tickets and your code.
- [QuanTum](https://keephustling.in/work/quantum): An equity research agent for Indian markets that scores stocks across three horizons and learns from its misses.
- [AccessShield](https://keephustling.in/work/accessshield): Four AI agents that audit a website for ADA compliance and explain the fixes in plain English.
- [Revenue Attribution Engine](https://keephustling.in/work/revenue-attribution-engine): An AI-weighted attribution and marketing-mix model for CX revenue.
- [Black Diamond Consulting](https://keephustling.in/work/black-diamond-consulting): A venture-capital consulting firm co-founded at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
- [OrganHub](https://keephustling.in/work/organhub): Coordinating organ donation across donors, NGOs, and hospitals.

## Blog

- [All posts](https://keephustling.in/blog): Stories and lessons on product, AI, and the long way round.
- [AI & Lead Identification: Uncovering the Gold in Rejected Conversations](https://keephustling.in/blog/the-gold-in-rejected-calls): Why the shortest sales calls often hold the most valuable intelligence.
- [From Darjeeling's Mist to IIT's Dreams: My Unlikely Journey](https://keephustling.in/blog/from-darjeeling-to-iit-dhanbad): How a sheltered kid from the hills, a pandemic, and YouTube led to IIT Dhanbad.
